normal_live_paths.mechanism: Post-acquisition explicit cut; canonical Registry/source identities; availability and receipt fences; final/fresh valid frames only; source revision ledger attached to Snapshot.
Reject missing/relative snapshot cut and unqualified frames. Filter source clocks at the explicit cut; feature caches bind cut and source revisions. Signals retain temporal source receipts.
Respect interval close AND receipt availability. Rolling ancestry and per-base decision cuts prevent forward alignment; missing remains unknown under negation.
Retain exact raw canonical/source envelope in existing Journal before use; reject future/reversed clocks and stale caches. No missing funding/OI zero; 24h OI change requires its full timed window.
Finite source-bound volume/listing receipts, with future-cache rejection and canonical identity checks. Snapshot lineage freezes selection/listing receipts.
Capture rejects unqualified/future/invalid feed frames; canonical/content/revision provenance is retained. Existing WorldState/WorldModel/perception temporal guards remain in force.
Exact validated raw source rows and post-request receipt clocks are annotated; historical capture cuts reject later acquisition. Custom/unproven venue identity remains UNKNOWN.
Existing registered public source gains canonical raw receipt lineage and request/scan clock-reversal rejection. Receipt records retained separately from unchanged content versions.
Read-only retained revision selection replaces raw overwrite-only SQL. Exact scan cut checks receipt and availability; unqualified records are UNKNOWN and excluded.
Reject source availability/receipt or signal cut after context cut, and reject future temporal ancestry; preserve existing world/scan/registry cut validation.

historical_paths.mechanism: Historical/as-of is offline only. Default compatibility cache read is bar-cut replay, with availability <= event+timeframe. Explicit historical cut never reaches latest-now.
Actual candle readers route through retained replay; cold/unqualified history remains unavailable. Latest-network fallback removed from strategy evidence.
Retain revision streams and select what was available at each bar cut. Later correction of an old event cannot displace a newer event; funding costs share availability alignment.
Reject qualified current/as-of snapshots from bar-cut backtests. Aggregate from actual constituent receipts; freeze derivation/version and interval/source identities; quality propagates.
Use retained replay rather than latest fetch; reject current snapshots; construct true completed 1h aggregates; truncate BTC context by actual availability; use bar-derived historical cut.
Persist per-scan exact acquisition receipts; reconstruct them without re-querying latest data; reject future receipt joins.
Raw copy is an unqualified inventory snapshot. Existing evaluate/referee DataFeed readers require retained revisions; a legacy copy with no receipt ledger yields no PIT evidence/admission.
Explicit collection remains a current acquisition operation. Collection does not backdate availability or supply bar-cut replay of newly acquired history.
Explicit later realized labels, not historical decision input. Source-bound normal feed receipts remain; no outcome re-labelled as information available before its receipt.

legacy_projection_semantics: candles/derivs/refs tables remain inventory projections. Qualified market reads use append-only retained market_revisions; historical availability is not inferred from old timestamps.
numerical_fixture_boundary: Pure numerical functions remain usable for synthetic engine checks. Actual live snapshot readers require provenance and actual historical data loaders require retained replay.
authority_boundary: Risk, Execution, StrategyVersion, Portfolio, Learning limits, Owner OS and first-live approval authority unchanged.
